tagline: A real estate finance company focused on commercial real estate debt investments and mortgage servicing
hero_kpi_rationale: The portfolio of commercial mortgage loans held for investment is the primary driver of revenue and assets for FBRT, representing the core of its commercial real estate lending business.

kpis.short: Commercial Mortgage Loans Held for Investment
kpis.name: Commercial Mortgage Loans Held for Investment
kpis.explanation: Carrying value of commercial mortgage loans that the company holds as investment assets.
kpis.description: This portfolio represents the core of FBRT's real estate financing activity. The approximately 10.7% decline between 2024 and 2025 reflects strategic contraction or de-allocation.

kpis.short: Real Estate Owned Held for Investment
kpis.name: Real Estate Owned Held for Investment
kpis.explanation: Real estate properties directly held by the company as investment assets.
kpis.description: These assets typically arise from real estate foreclosures or direct acquisitions following loan defaults.
kpis.signal: Long-term asset from foreclosures or direct purchases

kpis.name: Equity Method Investments
kpis.explanation: Investments in associated entities accounted for using the equity method.
kpis.description: The significant increase reflects the acquisition or expansion of investments in joint ventures or co-investments.

kpis.name: Non-Performing Loans
kpis.explanation: Loans whose repayment is overdue or considered risky, classified as non-performing.
kpis.description: The increase in non-performing loans reflects a deterioration in portfolio quality, likely tied to economic conditions or the real estate market.

kpis.name: Servicing Portfolio UPB
kpis.explanation: Total principal balance of loans the company services on behalf of other investors.
kpis.description: This $47.8 billion portfolio indicates FBRT plays a significant role in servicing commercial mortgage loans, even though it is not a consolidated asset.

kpis.name: Mortgage Servicing Rights
kpis.explanation: Intangible asset representing the right to collect fees for servicing mortgage loans.
kpis.description: MSRs are a strategic asset for generating recurring servicing revenue from commercial mortgage loan management.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.description: All employees are affiliated with NewPoint, acquired on July 1, 2025, indicating operational centralization.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €6.06 billion in the latest year

kpis.short: Commercial Mortgage Loans Held for Sale
kpis.name: Commercial Mortgage Loans Held for Sale
kpis.explanation: Mortgage loans the company holds temporarily for sale.
kpis.description: The sharp increase likely reflects the integration of NewPoint and an expanded strategy in commercial mortgage loan brokering.

kpis.name: Real Estate Securities AFS
kpis.explanation: Real estate securities the company may sell depending on market conditions.
kpis.description: The 25.3% decline between 2024 and 2025 suggests strategic de-allocation or realization of losses.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividend amount paid per share during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance ex-div dates.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends and buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity risk is a major concern for the company, as a security breach could have severe consequences on operations and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risk is mentioned in Item 1A Risk Factors, with high-intensity language, indicating significant concern for the company, particularly regarding the Advisor's systems.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary: The company must comply with strict regulations to maintain its REIT status and avoid penalties or fines.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations as a REIT, and non-compliance could have negative consequences.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition is a major risk for the company, as it could lose market share and revenue if it fails to differentiate itself from competitors.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with similar firms potentially attracting clients and investors.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.summary: Litigation is a risk for the company, but it does not appear to have a major impact on operations or reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in litigation, but these matters do not appear to have a significant impact on operations or reputation according to the 10-K.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.summary: The company's reputation is a valuable asset that must be protected to maintain client and investor confidence.
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is crucial for attracting clients and investors, and reputational damage could have negative consequences.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.summary: Geopolitical events are a risk for the company, as they could impact operations and revenues, particularly due to changes in trade policies or international relations.
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events could affect the company's operations and revenues, especially in the event of changes in trade policies or international relations.
